An absence inside until is recorded citing the commitment and is chargeable to the responder that signed it.
An absence with no commitment is evidence of nothing but the attempt.
A retention commitment naming a record subject.
cases.ambiguity: §3.1 Subject: -00 gives six forms and their content but no wire shape. Vectors use a map with exactly one member, named by the form token, whose value is the content: null for full_history and checkpoints, a digest for record and exchange, [a, b] (two unsigned integers) for range, a text string for correlation.
